summary: Completed the read-only multi-chat coordination observability surface in Icarus-engine. PR #182 exposes central active/waiting/stale/collision/owner state through the existing MCP / Automation UI without granting coordination mutation or broker authority. Exact-head tests run 38845896424 passed on 4b4861138f88e1f87fba19427daa80c826ba0df7, and the feature merged as 7d8da5fcea4afbb4fcc65d62ef31c7a0621d9624. The coordination mirror is hardened with an off-boundary five-minute cron, restored-five-local-shadow workflow_run fallback, manual dispatch, bounded fetch validation, and retry-on-main-movement publishing.
follow_ups: Every new AI/chat must use the canonical owner-actions START_HERE and directives rather than legacy model-specific board ownership.
Credential/provider discoverability is a separate federation bootstrap concern; agents must consume GitHub-native execution/evidence rather than search for plaintext keys.
Live broker arming remains disabled until explicit owner authorization.
